svg.aria-label: fasttime: rdtsc and vDSO clock reads take 16 to 20 ns; hpet and acpi_pm reads trap into the kernel
svg.title: fasttime: rdtsc and vDSO clock reads take 16 to 20 ns; hpet and acpi_pm reads trap into the kernel
svg.text: Is your Linux clock read secretly a system call? Median cost per read on a bare-metal laptop.
Each dot is one clock read
The fast lanes run at true relative speed. Kernel waits are shortened about 18× so those dots still move.
